svg.text: Heat molecular sample in oil bath
Use a silicone oil bath: 120 °C for 1 h, then 180 °C for 2 h. SI
spectra distinguish the first and second hour at 180 °C.
Conceptual operation diagram; only source-stated equipment and conditions apply.
